name: Springfield
original_name: スプリングフィールド
source:
"...Hello, Master.
I'm Springfield.
I'm a breech-loading rifle created by converting an old muzzle-loading gun.

I'm not very durable, and my lifespan is short, but...
As long as this body and this gun can function,
I will devote all my strength to carrying out your commands, Master.

I look forward to working with you from now on."
